record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The units in appliesTo declare SHORE_UP in this production reference. The strategy is shared; differences are star count, max HP, and (per cast) the weather.
record.summary: The caster heals itself by a fraction of its own current max HP (0.2 at 1 star, 0.25 at 2 stars, 0.4 at 3 stars, 0.8 at 4 stars and as fallback), plus 0.1 added to the fraction when the simulation weather is SANDSTORM (0.2 + 0.1 is 0.30000000000000004 in floating point, so the request is 300.00000000000006 for maxHP 1000 and is rounded inside handleHeal) (so 0.3 / 0.35 for the listed 1- and 2-star units), through handleHeal with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag. Because requiresTarget is false it can be cast without a target in range. Requested amount = healFactor x maxHP; the applied amount then follows the heal helper (PokemonState.handleHeal): a wounded caster gets 0 healing (this wound branch comes BEFORE the alive / protect guard: under BLOODMOON weather and with BLOOD_STONE items in the owner's inventory, addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the RAW request), apBoost 1, the cast's crit) is requested instead; the shield helper then applies the Big Eater Belt, AP, crit and the enraged halving itself and refuses a caster at 0 HP, and Protect does not stop it; executed: raw request 200 and 1 stone -> shield 60, AP 100 or a crit -> 120, enraged -> 30, Belt -> 75, a caster at 0 HP -> 0); a caster at hp 0 or with status.protect gets 0 (Rune Protect alone does not block it); otherwise x(1 + AP/100), x critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false), x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP. Overheal (taken from the rounded heal) on a caster with the GRASS synergy effect requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal, itself, apBoost 0, crit false, not permanent); addMaxHP rounds it, applies the Big Eater Belt and Twist Band helpers and raises hp by the same amount, clamped to the new maxHP (executed: hp 990 of 1000, request 200 -> overheal 190 -> request 76, maxHP 1076; with a Belt 95; AP 100 -> overheal 390 -> request 156). The strategy ignores the returned values. No damage, status, movement or shield of its own.

targeting.note: requiresTarget = false, the cast target is not used.

declaredRaw.label: requested heal = fraction of the caster's current max HP (healFactor, before AP/crit); +0.1 to the fraction in SANDSTORM

perUnitRaw.SANDYGAST: 0.2 x max HP (0.3 x max HP in SANDSTORM)
perUnitRaw.PALOSSAND: 0.25 x max HP (0.35 x max HP in SANDSTORM)

effects.scaling: requested = (table[stars-1] ?? 0.8, + 0.1 if simulation.weather === SANDSTORM) x pokemon.maxHP; then AP: x(1 + AP/100) because apBoost is 1; then x critPower only if the cast rolled a crit (canCritByDefault false, so this needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied: the wound check comes FIRST: a wounded caster (status.wound) gets 0 healing and, with BLOODMOON weather and BLOOD_STONE items, a requested addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw request), apBoost 1, crit) that PokemonEntity.addShield / PokemonState.addShield then scale (Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged x0.5) and refuse at 0 hp (see core-mechanics §J); otherwise 0 at 0 hp or with status.protect (Rune Protect alone blocks neither); otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather, rounded, capped at missing HP (maxHP - hp). The uncapped excess (overheal, from the rounded heal) requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal, itself, 0, false, false) if the caster has the GRASS synergy effect (not 40 % of max HP); addMaxHP rounds it, applies Belt and Twist Band and raises hp with maxHP. Requested, applied (healReceived) and overheal are separate amounts; the strategy ignores the returned values.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (0.4) and 4-star/fallback (0.8) values are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. maxPP 90, range 1 and max HP are in appliesTo / the unit blocks.

record.positionalConditions: None: the strategy reads no coordinates. One state condition: pokemon.simulation.weather === SANDSTORM adds 0.1 to the heal fraction.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and heals once; the weather is re-read on every cast. Healing is capped at missing HP, so a cast at full HP produces only overheal.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 0.2 (1 star) or 0.25 (2 stars) of the caster's current max HP, +0.1 of max HP in SANDSTORM, then x(1 + AP/100) [x critPower if the cast crit]. Applied: after the heal helper's wound / protect gate, modifiers (BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, burn, enraged, ZENITH), rounding and the cap at missing HP; the applied amount can be 0 and never exceeds missing HP. The remainder is overheal (GRASS: addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal)).

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleHeal, addShield, addMaxHP, the Belt and Twist helpers) and the real ShoreUpStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_C3); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (maxHP 1000, hp 500): requests 200 / 250 / 800 by stars, SANDSTORM 300.00000000000006 and 350, wound + BLOODMOON shield requests and finals, Protect and Rune Protect, the Grass overheal requests and finals.
